name: Rutherford County, TN
findings: Rutherford County has 734 nonprofit organizations. 286 of them (39%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 229 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (23% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Rutherford County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 71 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 71 organizations here; 43% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do religious organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?
